title: finding(skills): the domain table and the multi-repo rules give different lanes for an agent instruction file in a single-lane repo — #17163 sat undischargeable for 7 days on the ambiguity
body:
Two 细则 give different answers for **agent instruction files in a single-lane repository**, and nothing in either text settles the boundary. A live card sat undischargeable for a week because of it.

## The two rules, quoted

**域车道 table** (`SKILL.md`, the `domain:skills` row):

> `domain:skills` | governed 面全量(含本文件;统一定义见「governed 面统一定义」行)…

and the definition line it points at:

> governed 面同含 `AGENTS.md` + `CLAUDE.md`;**agent 指令文件跨仓同判**,仓集读 `GOVERNED_REPOS`,此处不列。

**多仓协调**:

> 单车道仓 `cloud`、`objectos`、`hotcrm`;未来新仓默认此类。
> **单车道仓 `repo:*` 席自理机械三务,⛔ 不产 `domain:*`**;…
> 规则 1:issue 住在**修复落地**的仓,分诊时按判据严格执行。

⇒ A `CLAUDE.md` edit landing in `cloud` is **governed surface** (⇒ `domain:skills` by the table) **and** lands in a **single-lane repo** (⇒ ⛔ no `domain:*`, the `repo:*` seat's, by the multi-repo rules). **Both readings are supported by the text as written.**

## The cost, measured — ⛔ this is not hypothetical

**objectstack#17163** carried **both** `repo:cloud` and `domain:skills` from 2026-09-09 to 2026-09-16. In that window:

| | |
|---|---|
| the `repo:cloud` seat | **declined** it (`5683694154`), citing 「agent instruction files are that lane's in every repo」 |
| the `domain:skills` seat | raised `pm:retriage` (`5701200790`), reporting it **cannot reach the landing repository at all** — its `list_repos` returns objectstack / objectui / hotcrm |
| the triage seat's own credential | same reading, twice (`5682536737` at R+236; re-measured R+253 with a lit control — 3 sibling repos return, `cloud` does not) |

⇒ **two lanes each pointed at the other, and the card was `pm:queue` — dispatchable by label, undischargeable in fact — for seven days.** That is precisely the shape objectstack#18299 names, and this is a worked instance of it.

## ⭐ Why this is a text gap and ⛔ not a seat error

Neither seat misread anything. 「跨仓同判」 is genuinely ambiguous between:

- **(i) the TREATMENT travels** — an agent instruction file is governed *wherever it lives* (draft PR, human merge, ⛔ no seat landing), while **execution** stays with the repo's own seat; and
- **(ii) the LANE travels** — objectstack's `domain:skills` seat owns edits to every repository's instruction files.

Reading (ii) contradicts 「单车道仓…⛔ 不产 `domain:*`」 and 「issue 住在修复落地的仓」. Reading (i) is consistent with both — but **the text does not say which**, and the row that would say it defers to `GOVERNED_REPOS` (「此处不列」), which enumerates **repositories**, ⛔ not lanes.

## What the triage seat did, and did not do

- **Did** (R+253, comment `5702130751`): ruled per 「两条细则冲突 ⇒ 按**更严的一条行动并立卡**」 — routed #17163 to the `repo:cloud` seat on the strength of the most specific rule for its situation (「目标仓不可达是读数缺口,不是落点:由**可达席**在目标仓立卡」), and stripped `domain:skills`.
- ⛔ **Did not** edit the domain table or the multi-repo section. 章程: 「⛔ 不当场改文本了结」. **This card is the 立卡 half of that rule.**

## ⛔ What this card does not propose

⛔ **No wording is proposed here.** Reading (i) is the triage seat's working interpretation and the basis of one routing decision — it is ⛔ **not** a ruling, and the skills lane may land the opposite. What is asked is only that **one of the two readings becomes the written one**, in whichever text the lane judges right.
⚠️ **NOT MEASURED**: how many other cards carry a `repo:*` + `domain:*` pair for this reason. #17163 was found by a `pm:retriage`, ⛔ not by a sweep. ⚠️ **#17165 is a named sibling** (same program, `pm:awaiting-maintainer`) and was ⛔ deliberately not touched. One query over the `repo:*` set would size the class before any fix is scoped.
